title: Find Maximum Number of Non Intersecting Substrings
summary: Given a string, determine the greatest count of non-overlapping substrings that are at least four characters long and begin and end with the same letter.
statement: Given a string, determine the greatest count of non-overlapping substrings that are at least four characters long and begin and end with the same letter.
constraints: word has up to 200,000 lowercase letters.
Choose non-overlapping substrings of length at least four.
Each chosen substring must start and end with the same letter; maximize the count.
hints: This is interval scheduling over every substring whose endpoints match and whose length is at least four.
Greedily take the first valid finishing position, using the earliest occurrence of each letter since the last selected interval.
Record first positions; when current index is at least three later than its letter’s first position, count the interval and reset all starts.
Earliest-finish greedy leaves at least as much suffix as any competing first interval, so exchanging choices never reduces the attainable count.
editorial: Earliest-finish greedy leaves at least as much suffix as any competing first interval, so exchanging choices never reduces the attainable count.

tests.explanation: Choosing abcdea followed by fdef gives two non-intersecting substrings.
The interval aaaa is valid, but the enclosing whole string overlaps it, so only one can be chosen.
